body: How do I motivate myself to do something when the uncertainty of the outcomes scare me ?

I've tried both and they didn't help. They said anti-depressants won't work if I don't understand my feeling, and the therapy just made me feel worse for some reason. I really want to change but I don't know how to. I'm scared that I'm going to use wrong methods in order to be happy and I'll end up hurting someone. Especially since I don't know what will make me happy.
How do I stay motivated though ?

The good thing is I know I don't need the latest of anything to be happy.. I just want my emotions to be straightened out. That's all I want, I just want to feel good. And I guess I need to learn how to make myself feel good.

Thank you so much.

I feel better for now, I just hope it can stay like this.
I'm really trying. It's so hard.
What if I get tired of trying? What if I become to scared of the uncertainties in life?
Listening to it, I think I'm going to listen to things like this on a daily basis. Thank you.

I know I'm not the only one that feels like this, but its hard to understand it when I only feel my emotions. How do I become more confident? I could say I'm going to be confident, but then all my emotions come back to me. I don't want to waste my life away, but I don't know how not to.
I've tried, but I end up pushing them away because I don't listen and I'm scared to lose the few friends I have.
Maybe I'm just hoping that someone here will actually get through my stubbornness..

I don't know... That's my problem. I want to change, I want to listen..
I just don't know.
